one_liner: Zelsius develops emissions calculation software for industry; rising pressure to cut emissions and ETH Zurich’s 2026 spin-off recognition make it worth approaching now.

top_signals.signal: ETH Zurich recognized Zelsius on its 2026 spin-off roster.
Zelsius received approximately CHF 15,000 from the Energy Lab in May 2023 and secured a Gerbert Rüf Stiftung grant in November 2023.

Model score 82.9 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). Four listed founders, university spin-off status and the deep-tech classification lifted the score. Flags for a technical founder and a founder from a top university also lifted it but are not confirmed by the founder records.

team: Four founders are listed: Adina Hochuli (Managing Director), Yannick Krabben (Head of Product Development), Lukas Hegner (Head of Research & Development), and Marcel Niederberger (Head of Marketing & Sales).
why_early: Priced-round status is unknown. The funding summary records two sources of support in 2023 and incorporation in June 2024, but does not establish whether a priced round has occurred.
devils_advocate_risks: Industrial customers may be reluctant to adopt new emissions calculation software.
It is unknown whether the software can handle different industrial processes across sectors.
next_step: HTGF Industrial Tech team: Ask the founders whether Zelsius has closed a priced equity round.
